records.title: LoRA-X: Low-Rank Adaptation with Sparse Kernels
records.abstract: We propose LoRA-X, a sparse-kernel variant of low-rank adaptation that cuts peak memory by 38% during fine-tuning of large language models while matching full fine-tuning accuracy on three benchmarks.
